# chameleon_effective_access (Data Source)

Show resolved effective permissions for a user on a resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Resolve which privileges a user effectively has on a table, including any
# inherited grants and policy decisions.
data "chameleon_effective_access" "alice_events" {
  catalog   = "analytics"
  namespace = "raw"
  table     = "events"
  user      = "alice"
}

output "alice_events_permissions" {
  value = data.chameleon_effective_access.alice_events.permissions
}
```
